text: Ship Healthcare Holdings, Inc. is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (code 3360). Its largest shareholders (as of 2025-09-30) were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account, 11.24%), Kokko Co., Ltd. (8.65%), State Street Bank and Trust Company (7.97%) and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account, 5.03%); no state or sovereign shareholder appears in the company's top-10 list.
short: Ship Healthcare Holdings is TSE-Prime listed (3360); top holders are trust banks and private companies, no state shareholder.
